# Embedded emissions: China-produced steel ingots (CN 7206 10 00)

**Total embedded emissions: 1,392.00 tCO2e**

## Required inputs
| Input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7206 10 00 (Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel) | In the table |
| (b) Country of production | China | Listed for this CN code |
| (c) Quantity | 800 tonnes | Provided |

All required inputs are present, so the calculation can go ahead.

## Factor selection
The default SEE is chosen by CN code and country together. For CN 7206 10 00 produced in China, the SEE is **1.74 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation
Embedded emissions = SEE × Quantity
= 1.74 tCO2e/t × 800 t
= **1,392.00 tCO2e**
